status: Stage 1 record proposal, not an implemented validator or ready package

asset.validation: Allowlisted same-origin immutable assets; byte/hash/shape check before adoption; finite nonzero vectors with declared norm tolerance; reject duplicates, unknown eligible IDs and mixed generations

route.invariant: Exactly one owner per coherent scope; prepared promises inputs, not a group

approach.invariant: Evaluate only the selected coherent approach; no sibling blending or invented sponsor requirements

aspect.invariant: Nonnegative approach weights sum to one; synonyms/split aspects share source group budget; optional total <=.1; missing descriptor stays missing

passage.invariant: All deduplicated claim references retained. Eligibility/visibility/active revision validate against atomic registry; interests never relabeled demonstrated work; no private text

computed_outcome.group_size: 2..4 automatically; selected state can be 0..4 after user edits or no-group
computed_outcome.invariant: All admitted people remain in discovery independently of group membership/evidence confirmation. No result stored as source ingredient. Empty group is valid v2 data. Quantized stable-ID ordering and immutable option identity per state.

provenance_link.invariant: Scores/word identity alone cannot promote evidence. Confirmed status requires an independent exact source-claim relation receipt bound to current revisions.
